title: scutellaria albida subsp. condensata
intro: Scutellaria albida subsp. condensata, commonly known as a type of Skullcap, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Scutellaria albida subsp. condensata are primarily attributed to its ability to act as a GABA receptor agonist, promoting relaxation and reducing muscle spasms. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as baicalein and baicalin, as well as terpenoids and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
